scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @dealport/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @dealport/api" "npm run dev -w @dealport/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dealport/shared && npm run build -w @dealport/api && npm run build -w @dealport/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @dealport/api && npm run lint -w @dealport/web
